text:
Night. Sea of silence. The meditations go

slowly unrolling their bright devotions.

The spirit’s lighthouse lights those gentle waves

that widen the circle of their evolutions

to govern the serene course of ships.

The peace of the soul that knows how to sing its hours

watches over that intimate life of seductive patterns

in which pain is loved. Why? Is it perhaps

that pain is the shadow of an affection? The hours

will tell you silently: walk step by step…

The hours lie. They lie. Indifference kills,

not knowing the triumph of a lovely cadence;

if you go through life step by step, swearing

that you have conquered, you deceive yourself: that poor belief

we keep who have always lived adoring…


Adore the despondency of that melancholy;

do not flee the gracious penumbra it grants.

The bird of twilight sings the melody

of what the soul could do, of what the soul can do!


Joy, one drop: that blessed drop

will have fallen into the glass the flower will enjoy…

Offer it to your soul for all its life

in the royal feast presided over by pain!

translation.title: Night. Sea of Silence. The Meditations Go...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the poem’s contemplative argument, its ellipses, and its closing feast governed by pain.
